_readme: Hand-authored reference dataset, NOT one of this project's published/versioned datasets — do not move to the repo root alongside casualties_daily.json etc. It exists so the StoriesInData 'death rate by age and sex' story has a pre-war population denominator. See site/src/components/StoriesInData/README.md for how it's used (age-shifted, then scaled to a 2023 total) and its licensing status below.
label: Gaza Strip population by 5-year age group and sex, Census 2017 (measured, final results)
geography: Gaza Strip (all 5 governorates: North Gaza, Gaza, Deir al-Balah, Khan Yunis, Rafah; all residents regardless of place of birth)

source.publication: Population, Housing and Establishments Census 2017: Census Final Results - Summary (Updated Version)
source.table: Table 3: Population in Palestine by Age Group, Sex and Governorate, 2017 (Gaza Strip column)
source.citation: Palestinian Central Bureau of Statistics, 2018. Population, Housing and Establishments Census 2017: Census Final Results - Summary. Ramallah - Palestine.

notes: Numbers extracted directly from the PDF text (pdftotext) of the official PCBS 'Census Final Results - Summary' report. This is the actually-counted census population by governorate; PCBS separately states the census total including a post-enumeration-survey undercount adjustment was 1,899,291 for Gaza Strip (vs. 1,875,317 actually counted) - the adjustment is not broken down by age/sex, so it is not reflected in the bands below.

sanity_checks.male_plus_female_total: 950735 + 924582 = 1875317 (matches Table 3 stated total and independently matches Table 1 of the Detailed Report)

scaling_reference.description: The 2023 Gaza Strip population total used to age this census forward to approximate the pre-war 2023 population — PCBS publishes no Gaza-only 5-year-band x sex table for any post-census year, so the census age/sex structure is scaled by this total-population ratio rather than replaced.

source.publication: Statistics Indicators Tables — "Estimated Population in Palestine Mid-Year by Region, 1997-2026"
source.footnote: By: Palestinian Central Bureau of Statistics, 2023. Revised Estimates based on the final results of Population, Housing and Establishments Census, 2017. Ramallah - Palestine. The page also carries a disclaimer that Gaza Strip estimates were prepared before 7 October 2023 and were later revised downward (to roughly 2.1 million by mid-2025) to reflect war casualties/displacement — that later revision is NOT reflected in the 2,226,544 figure used here, which is the pre-war projection.
